==Biography==
===2015 Season===
Ha "'''Kramer'''" Jong-hun originally played for [[Team GBK]] in [[Challengers Korea Spring 2015]] where they placed in the top eight in the second series. A short time later, he joined the [[Flash Wolves]] as a substitute for [[NL (Hsiung Wen-An)|NL]]. His first tournament with the team was the [[LMS/2015 Season/Summer Season|2015 LMS Summer Season]], where the Flash Wolves ended in second place. In the [[LMS/2015 Season/Summer Playoffs|2015 LMS Summer Playoffs]], FW lost 3-1 in the second round to [[Hong Kong Esports]]. They still had enough circuit points to qualify for the [[2015 Season Taiwan Regional Finals]] where they made it to the finals and took the second Taiwanese seed for the [[2015 Season World Championship]] with a 3-2 victory over HKES. At the World Championship, the FW were expected by many analysts to have one of the weakest showings of any team in attendance. However, after a 4-2 group stage with wins over favorites [[KOO Tigers]] and [[Counter Logic Gaming]], the Flash Wolves emerged first from groups, becoming the first team in two years to finish ahead of a Korean team in groups at Worlds. In the tournament quarterfinals, FW lost 1-3 to [[Origen]], earning a top eight finish. 

===2016 Preseason===
KKramer subbed for [[Young Boss]] in the [[2015 LoL KeSPA Cup]] but they lost 2-0 in the first round to [[CTU Pathos]]. KKramer left the Flash Wolves in November of 2015. KKramer joined [[CJ Entus]] as the starting AD Carry for the LCK Spring 2016 Season in December 2015.

===2016 Season===
During the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LCK Spring Season]], CJ went 8-10 in sets, finishing in eighth place overall for the spring split.

CJ Entus had a very poor showing in the [[LCK/2016 Season/Summer Season|2016 LCK Summer Season]], going 3-15 total in set score. Neither Kramer's performance nor that of the sub ADC [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]] seemed to make a difference in their abysmal results. Locked into tenth place in the LCK season, CJ Entus participated in the [[LCK/2017 Season/Spring Promotion|2017 LCK Spring Promotion]]. In the first round they were swept 2-0 by [[Kongdoo Monster]], bringing them down to the loser's bracket. There, they beat [[SBENU Korea]] 2-0 before falling to [[ESC Ever]] in a 3-0 sweep to become relegated from the LCK. This marked the first time an original Kespa team was relegated from the LCK.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''KKramer''' is a reference to the character '''John Kramer''' from the Saw franchise.
* Was introduced to Starcraft by his father at the age of 5.
* Started playing League of Legends in high school.
* Considers [[Deft]] the best AD carry.
* Favorite TV shows are [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infinite_Challenge Infinite Challenge] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Running_Man_(TV_series) Running Man].
